SafeMath.safeMul - multiplies with an assert based overflow check.
SafeMath.safeAdd - adds with an assert based overflow check.
StdToken.transfer - moves tokens from msg.sender to _to.
StdToken.transferFrom - moves tokens using an allowance.
StdToken.balanceOf - returns balance of an owner.
StdToken.approve - sets allowance from msg.sender to _spender.
MNTP constructor - sets creator to msg.sender and asserts supply.
MNTP.transfer - lockTransfers guarded override calling super.transfer.
MNTP.transferFrom - lockTransfers guarded override calling super.transferFrom.
GoldmintUnsold constructor - sets creator, teamAccountAddress and mntToken.
GoldmintUnsold.withdrawTokens - public, timelocked transfer of all tokens to team account.
FoundersVesting constructor - sets teamAccountAddress, lastWithdrawTime and mntToken.
FoundersVesting.withdrawTokens - public monthly withdrawal of 1/10 of tokens.
Goldmint constructor - wires creator, multisig, managers, token and unsold contracts.
Goldmint.startICO - mints founders rewards, locks transfers, records start time.
Goldmint.startRefunding - requires soft cap not reached and transfers locked.
Goldmint.finishICO - unlocks transfers, moves unsold tokens and sends ETH to multisig.
Goldmint.isIcoFinished - time or sold-out based ICO termination check.
Goldmint.setState - public state machine transition with authorization logic.
Goldmint.getMntTokensPerEth - computes discounted price with unchecked arithmetic.
Goldmint.buyTokens - payable token purchase in ICORunning state.
Goldmint.issueTokensExternal - onlyTokenManager bonus issuance limited by BONUS_REWARD.
Goldmint.issueTokensInternal - internal issuance capped by ICO_TOKEN_SUPPLY_LIMIT.
Goldmint.getMyRefund - refunds ETH to msg.sender and burns tokens in Refunding state.
Goldmint fallback - buys tokens for msg.sender.
msg.sender - attacker controlled caller identity used for authorization and balances.
block.timestamp (now) - miner influenced time used for ICO and vesting locks.
External ETH transfer sender.transfer(buyers[sender].weiSent) inside Goldmint.getMyRefund.
External ETH transfer multisigAddress.transfer(this.balance) inside Goldmint.finishICO.
Unchecked multiplications/divisions computing price in Goldmint.getMntTokensPerEth (Solidity 0.4).
